title: Component composition of adjunction mates
statement: Let A, B, D, E be categories with adjunctions P:B→A ⊣ R, Q:D→B ⊣ S, H:E→D ⊣ G, T:D→A ⊣ V, F:E→A ⊣ Rf and K:E→B ⊣ Rk. Let α:F→K⋙P, β:K→H⋙Q, γ:F→H⋙T and τ:T→Q⋙P be natural transformations satisfying α followed by whiskerRight(β,P) = γ followed by whiskerLeft(H,τ). Let t:R⋙S→V, a:R⋙Rk→Rf, b:S⋙G→Rk and c:V⋙G→Rf be, respectively, the right-adjoint conjugates of τ, α, β and γ, using the indicated composite adjunctions. Then for every M in A, G(t_M) followed by c_M = b_(RM) followed by a_M.

proof.text: Given six adjunctions and a componentwise commuting square α_N followed by P(β_N) = gamma_N followed by τ_(H N), use natural-transformation extensionality to obtain the corresponding whiskered square. Conjugate that equation; the conjugate composition formula reverses the two factors. Formal category and adjunction identities: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Mates; composed adjunction associativity in the proved source library.

The left and right whiskering formulas identify its edges as the four indicated right-adjoint mates; associativity of composite adjunctions identifies the middle adjunctions. Formal category and adjunction identities: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Mates; composed adjunction associativity in the proved source library.

lean.statement:
theorem conjugateComposition_app
    {A B D E : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Category D] [Category E]
    {P : B ⥤ A} {R : A ⥤ B} {Q : D ⥤ B} {S : B ⥤ D}
    {H : E ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ E} {T : D ⥤ A} {V : A ⥤ D}
    {F : E ⥤ A} {Rf : A ⥤ E} {K : E ⥤ B} {Rk : B ⥤ E}
    (ap : P ⊣ R) (aq : Q ⊣ S) (ah : H ⊣ G) (ac : T ⊣ V)
    (af : F ⊣ Rf) (ak : K ⊣ Rk)
    (α : F ⟶ K ⋙ P) (β : K ⟶ H ⋙ Q) (gamma : F ⟶ H ⋙ T) (τ : T ⟶ Q ⋙ P)
    (hc : ∀ N, α.app N ≫ P.map (β.app N) =
      gamma.app N ≫ τ.app (H.obj N))
    (t : R ⋙ S ⟶ V) (a : R ⋙ Rk ⟶ Rf) (b : S ⋙ G ⟶ Rk) (c : V ⋙ G ⟶ Rf)
    (ht : conjugateEquiv (aq.comp ap) ac τ = t)
    (ha : conjugateEquiv (ak.comp ap) af α = a)
    (hb : conjugateEquiv (ah.comp aq) ak β = b)
    (hg : conjugateEquiv (ah.comp ac) af gamma = c) (M : A) :
    @Eq (G.obj (S.obj (R.obj M)) ⟶ Rf.obj M)
      (G.map (t.app M) ≫ c.app M) (b.app (R.obj M) ≫ a.app M)
